products.screenshotAlt: Mockoon desktop application for designing and running mock REST APIs

mockoon.title: Mockoon: powerful API mocking
mockoon.body: Mockoon lets you design and run mock REST APIs in seconds—locally, with no account and no remote setup. Built and maintained by 1kB as free, open-source software.

responses.title: Test more than the happy path
responses.body: Create multiple responses for each route, match requests with rules and simulate latency or errors. Customize headers, status codes and bodies, or test real-time behavior with WebSockets and callbacks.

data.title: Realistic, stateful data
data.body: Generate dynamic responses with templates and request values. Use JSON data buckets with CRUD routes to let tests create, read, update and delete records instead of relying on fixed fixtures.

openapi.title: Work with your API specification
openapi.body: Import Swagger or OpenAPI definitions to bootstrap a mock, then export your API when you need to share its structure. Serve files and configure CORS or HTTPS to match your integration.

proxy.title: Record, inspect and proxy
proxy.body: Inspect request and response logs, capture a real API's behavior and replay it locally. Forward unmatched routes to the real backend while mocking only the endpoints you need.

automation.title: From desktop to CI
automation.body: Design APIs in the desktop application and run them headlessly with the CLI. Use Docker, GitHub Actions or other CI pipelines, or the serverless library for function-based deployments.

offline.title: Local by default
offline.body: The open-source tools work offline without an account or cloud deployment. Run multiple mock APIs and routes without limits, and keep development fixtures under your control.

browser.title: An embedded web workspace
browser.body: Create and edit mock APIs in the browser, alongside the desktop workflow. Manage running mock deployments on your own infrastructure.

collaboration.title: Shared APIs, coordinated teams
collaboration.body: Synchronize APIs across devices and collaborate in real time. Manage users with local accounts or OpenID Connect single sign-on, and follow instance activity through an audit trail.

hosting.title: Self-hosted deployment
hosting.body: Deploy Mockoon Pro on-premises, in a private cloud or on an isolated network. Your team controls the environment where mock APIs and workspace data are hosted.

training.customBody: Choose the topics, depth and pace that fit your team. From language fundamentals to architecture, performance, testing and tooling, we adapt the exercises to your experience and projects. Topics include:

cta.title: Looking for training for your team?

api.title: Designing, Building, and Testing Modern APIs
api.summary: Design reliable REST APIs and follow their lifecycle through implementation, documentation, mocking and testing. A practical course for developers working with integrations.
api.prerequisites: Basic knowledge of HTTP, JSON and client-server architecture, and familiarity with a programming language. Postman or curl experience is helpful but not required.

topics.one: REST principles, HTTP methods, status codes and data formats.
topics.two: API design, documentation, versioning and error handling.
topics.five: Mocking, integration testing and a workshop building and testing your own API.

typescript.title: Mastering TypeScript: From JavaScript to Reliable Applications
typescript.summary: Use static typing to make JavaScript projects more reliable. Build and refactor code with TypeScript while developing practical typing and configuration skills.
typescript.prerequisites: Solid JavaScript fundamentals and basic HTML and CSS knowledge. Experience with a JavaScript framework is a plus.

topics.one: Transpilation, compiler configuration, basic types and inference.
topics.two: Interfaces, type aliases, classes, enums and typed functions.
topics.three: Generics, conditional types, mapped types and utility types.
topics.four: Modules and integration into existing JavaScript projects.
topics.five: Debugging, refactoring and maintainable typing patterns for larger codebases.

angular.title: Building Modern Web Applications with Angular
angular.summary: Build a modular Angular application through guided exercises. Learn the core framework concepts, reactive data flow and practical techniques for maintainability, performance and testing.
angular.prerequisites: Basic HTML, CSS and JavaScript knowledge, plus an understanding of object-oriented programming. Previous web development experience is recommended.

topics.one: Angular architecture, TypeScript, application structure and reusable components.
topics.two: Templates, data binding, directives, control flow and component communication.
topics.three: Services, dependency injection, routing, HTTP and reactive forms.
topics.four: RxJS, Signals, state management, OnPush and performance optimization.
topics.five: HTTP error handling, unit and integration testing, debugging and an overview of SSR/SSG and libraries.

git.title: Mastering Git and GitHub: Practical Collaboration for Modern Teams
git.summary: Make version control a confident part of your daily workflow. Practice managing changes, collaborating through GitHub and resolving common problems in a shared repository.
git.prerequisites: Basic command-line knowledge and confidence managing files. No previous Git or GitHub experience required.

topics.one: Git setup, local and remote repositories, commits, push and pull.
topics.two: Branches, merges, conflict resolution and rebasing.
topics.three: GitHub pull requests, code reviews and collaborative workflows.
topics.four: Issues, Discussions, Projects, GitHub Flow and Git Flow.
topics.five: Commit conventions, troubleshooting and a practical workshop creating and merging a pull request.
